title.narrative: Water supply and environmental sanitation in Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Provision and preservation of water tanks and their surroundings, safety of septic tanks, prevention of leaks, provision of toilets, maintenance of a safe and sound environment, sustainability of project activities with periodic maintenance / availability of designated places for placing, collecting and disposing of waste in a safe, environmentally healthy manner while limiting the spread of rodents and disease vectors and spreading the degree of awareness (51,128) beneficiaries with the displaced in a clean healthy environment

Saving life, maintaining its continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and securing a safe, healthy and safe environment for the displaced and citizens by providing basic services in the water and environmental sanitation sector through the maintenance of wells and pumps and the establishment of a drinking water desalination plant.

Securing safe and healthy sources of water in the areas where the displaced gather in Hajjah governorate (Hiran / Midi / Abs) / Disposing of waste and waste in a safe and healthy manner / Preventive maintenance of water and sanitation tanks and toilets / Raising awareness of citizens and displaced people
